releaseOrder.name: Governed CRM Foundation
releaseOrder.exitGate: 100% of open leads have owner, stage, next action, consent state, and last activity.

releaseOrder.name: Scheduling and Daily Operations
releaseOrder.exitGate: Appointments can be booked, confirmed, rescheduled, and completed; all events appear in CRM; missed appointments create follow-up tasks.

releaseOrder.name: Governed Communications
releaseOrder.exitGate: No communication is sent without a policy check; opt-outs are immediate; every outbound message has a template or approval record.

releaseOrder.name: AI Assistance
releaseOrder.exitGate: Every AI action is logged; restricted actions require approval; RAG responses cite approved sources; AI cannot independently make product recommendations.

releaseOrder.name: PRIMETIME Academy
releaseOrder.exitGate: Learners receive measurable mastery and readiness reports; weak topics generate study assignments.

releaseOrder.name: Insurance Lifecycle
releaseOrder.exitGate: A client can be tracked from first lead through active policy servicing; every stage has required evidence and audit history.

releaseOrder.name: Controlled Voice
releaseOrder.exitGate: AI disclosure is enforced; opt-outs are respected; calls are logged; human transfer works; restricted sales behavior is blocked.

releaseOrder.name: Growth Modules
releaseOrder.exitGate: Core modules maintain agreed reliability, adoption, and compliance targets.
